parts.text: A shop sells only one type of office chair. The shop buys these chairs from a maker. In one year the shop buys 600 of these chairs.

content.tex: A shop sells only one type of office chair. The shop buys these chairs from a maker. In one year the shop buys 600 of these chairs.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Buying cost It costs the shop $240 to buy one of these chairs from the maker. This is the buying cost for one chair. Find the total buying cost for the 600 chairs. ............................................................. [2]

content.tex: Buying cost It costs the shop \(\$240\) to buy one of these chairs from the maker. This is the buying cost for one chair.
Find the total buying cost for the 600 chairs.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Because of lack of space and money the shop cannot buy all the 600 chairs at once. Instead, it buys x chairs at a time. This is called an order for x chairs. Write down an expression for the number of orders the shop makes in one year. ............................................................. [1]

content.tex: Because of lack of space and money the shop cannot buy all the 600 chairs at once. Instead, it buys \(x\) chairs at a time. This is called an order for \(x\) chairs.
Write down an expression for the number of orders the shop makes in one year.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Ordering cost For each order there is a cost, called the ordering cost. This is for filling in forms and checking the delivery. The shop has an ordering cost of $32 for each order. Use your answer to 5(b) to find an expression for the total ordering cost in one year. Write your answer as a single fraction. ............................................................. [2]

content.tex: Ordering cost For each order there is a cost, called the ordering cost. This is for filling in forms and checking the delivery. The shop has an ordering cost of \(\$32\) for each order.
Use your answer to 5(b) to find an expression for the total ordering cost in one year. Write your answer as a single fraction.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The shop stores the chairs that it orders.

content.tex: The shop stores the chairs that it orders.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Before the delivery of an order the shop has 0 chairs. After the delivery of an order the shop has x chairs. The shop estimates that the number of chairs that it stores at any time is the mean of 0 and x. Write down an expression in terms of x for the mean of 0 and x. ............................................................. [1]

content.tex: Before the delivery of an order the shop has 0 chairs. After the delivery of an order the shop has \(x\) chairs.
The shop estimates that the number of chairs that it stores at any time is the mean of 0 and x.
Write down an expression in terms of \(x\) for the mean of 0 and x.
